It all started with an interview I did with @Kylervcreator  a 23-year-old making $10,000/month renting out $50 washers and dryers on Facebook Marketplace. Then I flew to Utah to film a full real-life episode showing exactly how his business worked — and that one blew up, now passing 1.4 million views and inspiring tons of new appliance rental businesses across the country.

Now, in this update episode, Kyler flew to Texas to prove that you can still start this business from scratch — even in one of the most competitive and “oversaturated” markets in the U.S. We answered all your top questions from the comments, showed exactly how to launch from zero, and even rented out two sets the same day.
